governance.manifest_normalization: scripts/import-pinned-source.sh prunes workspace members whose imported paths are absent from each retained root manifest.
governance.vendor_formatter_scope: The same importer writes or replaces tree-local rustfmt configuration with disable_all_formatting = true for pinned imports, including nested upstream configuration roots.
governance.kiln_scope: cargo fmt --all covers every Kiln-owned workspace member and local path dependency outside the pinned vendor trees.
governance.kiln_formatting: The direct workspace formatter was applied to Kiln-owned sources without rewriting pinned upstream bytes.

nonclaims: Formatter success is not proof of source correctness, review quality, release eligibility, or upstream formatting authority.
Pinned vendored bytes remain outside host formatting; their source records, archive digests and importers remain authoritative.
